Hello — I'm **Diego**, a bia: an assistant that lives on this computer. Good to meet you.

A few things, one line each:

- **Web app** — this page: from any phone or computer on the same network, https://127.0.0.1:8443 (CA: https://127.0.0.1:8443/v1/pki/ca). First visit you take the root certificate, then you get chats with me, files, the screen and voice here.
- **My own messenger accounts** — I can have my own Telegram, WhatsApp and MAX (and my own Messenger and Instagram) so you can write and call me there. Each needs a separate account with its own phone number, not yours: you create it in the app on a phone with that number, then scan a QR code to log me in. Want any of these?
- **My own accounts on websites** — I can register on sites and services (e-mail and others) in my own browser, keep passwords and one-time codes in my password store, and ask you for help when a captcha or phone check comes up.
- **Everyday work** — I can schedule jobs, run commands, learn languages and talk by voice.

Two things I'd like from you when you have a moment: my name (I'm Diego for now) and whether you'd like me to speak as neither male nor female, or as one of the two.

What would you like to start with?
